name: Manual Therapy
description: Hands-on techniques to mobilize joints and soft tissues, reducing pain and improving range of motion for musculoskeletal conditions.

name: Electrotherapy (TENS/IFT)
description: Electrical stimulation therapy using TENS and Interferential Therapy to reduce pain, improve circulation and accelerate tissue healing.

name: Ultrasound Therapy
description: Deep tissue ultrasound waves to promote healing of tendons, ligaments and muscles by increasing blood flow and reducing inflammation.

name: Stroke Rehabilitation
description: Comprehensive neurological rehabilitation for stroke survivors to regain motor control, balance, coordination and independence.

name: Parkinson's Therapy
description: Specialized physiotherapy to improve gait, balance, and motor function in patients with Parkinson's disease using LSVT BIG techniques.

name: Spinal Cord Injury Rehab
description: Intensive rehabilitation program for spinal cord injury patients focusing on maximizing functional independence and quality of life.

name: Sports Injury Recovery
description: Targeted physiotherapy for athletes recovering from acute and chronic sports injuries, designed to restore full performance capacity.

name: ACL Rehabilitation
description: Progressive 6-phase ACL rehabilitation protocol from post-surgery to return-to-sport, including strength, proprioception and agility training.

name: Dry Needling
description: Intramuscular stimulation technique targeting myofascial trigger points to relieve chronic muscle pain and improve function.

name: Kinesio Taping
description: Application of elastic therapeutic tape to support muscles and joints, reduce swelling and improve proprioception during recovery.

name: Posture Correction
description: Systematic assessment and correction of postural imbalances causing chronic pain through targeted exercises and ergonomic education.

name: Balance & Vestibular Therapy
description: Specialized exercises for vertigo, dizziness and balance disorders using vestibular rehabilitation techniques.
